Where every spec of WoW: Midnight stands — every major tier list distilled into one consensus, layered with live numbers, sim profiles, and per-spec PTR reads.
How to read itSeveral tier lists feed a computed consensus, with a ± marker where they disagree — flip between them with View, or pick Ours: 12.1 ✦ for this site's own Season-2 forecast (a projection, never a source). Filter by era or a specific fight, and click any row for the full read: PTR changes, current numbers with ranks, sim fight profile, and community takes. Three tools up top: 🧭 Find my spec ranks all 40 against what you want to play, 📊 The Ladder draws any measured ranking as a chart, and ⊞ Compare all is the whole roster against every rating and rank on one screen.

what that meansSim numbers (Bloodmallet, SimC) desync between PTR and live and run immature rotations. PTR log cuts (WCL zones 52/54/56, Robydoby) are real player parses, but on tiny, tuning-in-flux samples (n often <100). Treat all of it as directional until ~2 weeks of live logs confirm it.
